name: rc2poly
comment: Sig [a,efinal]=rc2poly(k,r0): reflection coeffs -> AR poly via step-up. k=[-0.5 0.4 0.2] -> a=[1 -0.62 0.26 0.2]. Two-output form [a,efinal]=rc2poly([0.5 0.3],4): a=[1 0.65 0.3], efinal=r0*prod(1-k.^2)=4*0.75*0.91=2.73. numkit previously returned only a (no efinal 2nd output) -- added r0 arg + efinal.
